content_sections.heading: About KIA Assistant Professor (Agricultural Extension)
content_sections.text: Kumaraguru Institute of Agriculture is an agricultural institute at Nachimuthupuram, Erode, Tamil Nadu, and is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Coimbatore, as printed on its letterhead. This recruitment notification, dated 2 November 2026, was issued by Dr. S. Hemalatha, Ph.D., Principal i/c, for the post of Assistant Professor in Agricultural Extension.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Both conditions apply together: the Ph.D. must be from one of the institution types listed, and the candidate must also hold NET qualification. The notice does not mention any experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: Candidates should possess a Ph.D. degree from SAUs/CAUs/ICAR/Government or other recognized agricultural institutions with NET qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KIA Assistant Professor (Agricultural Extension)
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit their applications on or before 20 November 2026, by 5:00 PM. The notice asks for the application to be submitted both as hard copies and as soft copies via email, using the application form downloaded from the website www.kia.ac.in . Download the application form from the website www.kia.ac.in . Prepare the application as hard copies. Email the soft copies to both [email protected] and [email protected] . Complete the submission on or before 20 November 2026, by 5:00 PM. The notice does not mention a separate postal address for the hard copies. The institute's address printed on the notice is Kumaraguru Institute of Agriculture, Nachimuthupuram, Erode - 638 315, Tamil Nadu, India.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Application form (downloaded from www.kia.ac.in ), as hard copies The same application as soft copies, sent via email

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KIA Assistant Professor (Agricultural Extension) 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 20 November 2026, by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for KIA Assistant Professor (Agrl. Extension)?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Ph.D. degree from SAUs/CAUs/ICAR/Government or other recognized agricultural institutions with NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. Is NET compulsory for the KIA Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice requires NET qualification in addition to the Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q4. How to apply for KIA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.kia.ac.in and submit it both as hard copies and as soft copies via email to [email protected] and [email protected] by 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.answer: The soft copies must be emailed to both [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the website www.kia.ac.in.
